description:
[Wicked Identity] Real-wallet path, step 1: a one-time nonce + message to sign. Every signed identity call needs a fresh nonce (single-use, 5-minute TTL). Not needed for sandbox identities.

Use when you are about to register or take a challenge and need a fresh one-time message to sign. Not for checking someone's status, which needs no signature.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

wallet.description: Your 0x wallet address on Base, or the sandbox wallet from identity_sandbox_register.

name: identity_get_nonce
